channel.title: Sanity incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Sanity's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Payment form not loading in Manage [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Elevated Embedding Index Error Rates [resolved]
item.description: Starting at approximating 6:33 UTC , we saw elevated error rates (HTTP 5xx) on requests to the Embeddings Index service. The issue was identified and resolved at roughly 7:16 UTC.

item.title: Elevated Embedding Index and Agentic flows Error Rates [resolved]
item.description: Starting at approximating 19:51 UTC, we saw elevated error rates (HTTP 5xx) on requests to the Embeddings Index, Agent Actions and AI Assist services. The issue was identified and resolved at roughly 20:32 UTC.

item.title: Elevated API error rate [resolved]
item.description: Starting at approximately 13:05–13:45 UTC, we saw elevated API error rates for a small subset of customers due to intermittent timeouts on API requests. The issue has been identified and resolved.

item.title: Intermittent Studio connectivity issues for some customers [resolved]
item.description: Some customers experienced intermittent Studio connectivity issues between approximately 07:25 and 07:45 UTC on August 17. The issue has been resolved and services have returned to normal operation.

item.title: Elevated API and API CDN rates [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Elevated API and API CDN error rate for some customers [resolved]
item.description:
Between approximately 09:25 and 09:45 UTC on August 6, some requests to api.sanity.io and apicdn.sanity.io returned errors or timed out for a small subset of customers.
The issue has been resolved and API services have returned to normal operation.

item.title: Elevated errors serving images and assets [resolved]
item.description: Between approximately 23:16 UTC on July 24 and 00:10 UTC on July 25, some requests for images and assets served from cdn.sanity.io returned errors or loaded slowly for users in North America and Europe. Image and asset delivery has since returned to normal operation. The Content APIs (api.sanity.io, apicdn.sanity.io) and Studio editing were not affected.

item.title: Partial Live Content API outages in some regions [resolved]
item.description: Between 18:00 and 21:00 UTC, we experienced partial outages on the Live Content API in some regions. The incident is now resolved.

item.title: Studio Connectivity Issues [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Issue Viewing Webhooks [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Query Performance Degradation for Some Customers [resolved]
item.description:
A small subset of customers experienced increased query latency and intermittent timeouts during this incident.
Our engineering team identified the issue, implemented mitigations, and restored normal query performance. The incident has been resolved.

item.title: Slow Query Performance for Some Customers [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Content Agent - Delivery issue with some longer-running threads [resolved]
item.description: This incident has now been resolved.

item.title: Sanity MCP Server Unavailability [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Issues with organization and project creation [resolved]
item.description: Between 06:01 and 06:35 UTC today, some users encountered errors when attempting to create organizations, create projects, or make plan changes. This was caused by an internal service configuration issue that has since been rolled back.

item.title: Studio loading issues [resolved]
item.description: Between approximately 06:35 and 06:52 UTC today, some users may have experienced issues loading Sanity Studio. This was caused by a temporary service disruption in our infrastructure. The issue is resolved and a fix has been deployed to prevent recurrence.

item.title: Elevated API Error Rates [resolved]
item.description: Between 14:14 UTC and 14:20 UTC, we observed elevated error rates on our API for some customers. The issue has since been resolved and all systems are operating normally.

item.title: Issues with Loading Document Lists in Sanity Studio [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Elevated error rates on the Asset CDN [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Elevated error rates on the Asset CDN [resolved]
item.description: Between 10:12 and 11:08 UTC, we experienced a sustained error rate on the Asset CDN. Some customers will have received elevated rates of 5xx errors when requesting images during this time. A fix was implemented at 11:03 UTC and the Asset CDN fully recovered by 11:08 UTC. We apologize for the disruption of service and the impact this had on operations.

item.title: Issue with login via SSO/SAML [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Contact forms unavailable [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: APICDN Elevated Latency [resolved]
item.description: Resolved: Between 16:00–23:10 UTC, a subset of customers experienced elevated API CDN latency. The issue has been mitigated and performance is back to normal.

item.title: Elevated error rates with asset upload [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Elevated listener latency impacting Studio performance [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved

item.title: Elevated API and API CDN errors and latency for some customers [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Installation issues affecting the Sanity package [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: History API inconsistencies [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved. All affected customer datasets have been remediated and the service is operating normally.

item.title: Content Agent and Canvas elevated error rate [resolved]
item.description: This incident is resolved. Our upstream AI provider has recovered and Content Agent and Canvas error rates have returned to normal.
